children: Germany's federal and state government tax revenue rose by 1.7% in August compared with the same month a year ago, the finance ministry said in its monthly report on Tuesday.
Total tax revenue reached €64.3 billion ($73.7 billion)
There were revenue increases from the wage tax, the withholding tax on interest and capital gains, as well as value-added tax
Tax revenue for the January-to-August period rose by 0.9% year-on-year to €581.8 billion
Tax experts see tax revenue increasing to €912.7 billion in 2026, up 1.2% year-on-year
